newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firm on good demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firm on good demand.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices firmed on strong general demand at the weekly tea auction held in Mombasa on Monday, auction officials said.

Brighter and medium BP1s were firmer by eight U.S. cents, while lower mediums were fully firm by one cent. Brighter PF1s rose by three cents, while lower mediums were firm by two cents. Brighter PDusts were generally easier, while mediums held firm. Brighter and lower medium DUST1s were firm by two cents.
In the secondary catalogues, BMFs were a strong feature and gained value.
Pakistan blenders, Egypt and Sudan were very strong.
